summary: The Data Reliability Engineer ensures the availability, stability, and performance of large scale data systems and pipelines across the organization.
responsibilities: Monitor and maintain operational health of data pipelines and platforms
Implement alerts, monitoring, and automated remediation for data workflows
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and system failures
Collaborate with engineering, data science, and platform teams
Enforce best practices for reliability, scalability, and observability

education: 4–7 years of experience in reliability engineering for data systems

skills_required.name: Strong experience in monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK,
Distributed data systems experience (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka)
